pool.b.jugend_befoerderung_vorschlag_gru: Coach, I am writing to you about the academy, please take your time with this.
Coach, here is a proposal from the academy that matters a great deal to me.
pool.b.jugend_befoerderung_vorschlag_lag: One of the juniors is so far along that I can hardly challenge him there any longer.
One of my lads has outgrown his age group, and I see nobody there who can make him better.
The boy runs rings around his peers, and I will not be told any longer that he is not ready yet!
I have watched for weeks how he is under-challenged, and it drives me mad!
I have worked for this academy for years, and we rarely had one like him, which is why he means so much to me.
I have guided the boy since he was small and would never propose him if I did not firmly believe in it.
This boy can become a figurehead of the club, and I do not want us to sleep through it.
If we guide him properly now, he will soon be at the top, and that is exactly what I want for the academy.
I will say it openly: other clubs are already watching him, and nothing will hold him here for long unless we bring him up.
The boy will not wait forever, and I fear we lose him to a rival if nothing happens.
I thought long about whether to burden you with this, but the boy deserves an honest chance.
It is not easy for me to bring this up, because I know what it means for the boy.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_gruss: Hello coach, I am writing to you about the playing time of the juniors.
Coach, I have to write to you about the juniors, and it cannot wait.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage: Several lads have sat only on the bench or in the stand for weeks and get no minute of match practice.
It is showing with some of our juniors that they hardly play any more. They train, but without matches they stagnate.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage.hitzig: A handful of talents are rotting away on the substitutes' bench, and I will not watch it any longer!
We are ruining good lads right now because nobody lets them play, and that is a scandal!
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage.loyal: I stand behind the club's course, but several juniors get too little playing time, and it gnaws at me.
I go along with a lot, but I cannot silently accept that the lads hardly get to play.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage.ehrgeizig: Without competition our talents will never reach the top, and that is our goal.
We want to train players for the first eleven, and you only learn that in matches, not on the bench.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage.wechselfr: If the lads get no appearances here they will look for other clubs, and I cannot blame them.
A few agents are already calling because their clients do not play with us. I can understand them.
pool.b.jugend_ohne_spiele_lage.sensibel: The lads show nothing, but I see how quiet they become after matchdays.
You can see how much it weighs on them to only watch, even if they say nothing.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_gruss: Coach, do you have a moment? The parents of a talent came to see me.
Coach, may I speak to you in private? It is about the family of one of our lads.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage: His parents want to know how things go on for their son, and no longer accept stock phrases.
The boy's family put me through the wringer. They want to clear up prospects, school and pay.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage.hitz: The parents are upset and demand answers, and I cannot give them any that would be enough!
The father almost shouted at me today, that is how hard they press me with their questions!
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage.loya: The parents are decent people and trust the club. That is exactly why they only want an honest word.
The family has always supported us and drives the boy every day. They deserve an honest answer.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage.ehrg: The parents firmly believe in a great career for their son and want to know whether we pave that way.
The father already sees his son with the professionals. He expects a clear plan from us for it.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage.wech: The family's agent hinted that other clubs are interested too. That puts pressure on the talk.
The parents let it show that they would look elsewhere too if we offer no prospects.
pool.b.jugend_eltern_gespraech_lage.sens: The mother was close to tears because she does not know whether her son is in good hands here.
The parents worry whether the boy can handle the pressure, and that has made me thoughtful myself.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_gruss: Coach, I am writing to you with bad news from the academy.
Coach, there is trouble, and I want you to be the first to hear of it.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage: Another club has knocked on the door of one of our talents and made him an offer.
A rival is trying to detach one of our lads from the academy.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage.hitzig: Another club is poaching in our academy, and I want us not to put up with it!
Someone comes along and lures our boy with promises he will never keep!
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage.loyal: I am attached to the boy, and it hurts me that another club is turning his head.
For years I have put work into the academy, and now someone reaches out a hand for our talent.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage.ehrgeizig: The boy is one of the best talents we have, and that is exactly why the others want him.
If we keep him we have a future key player, and our rivals know that.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage.wechselfreu: Honestly, the offer sounds not bad for him, and I understand that he is curious.
The boy is already eyeing the other club, and I can hardly blame him for listening.
pool.b.jugend_abwerbung_lage.sensibel: The boy is torn, and I notice how much the matter upsets him.
He did not sleep last night, that is how much the offer occupies him.
